reviewNotes: HOLD - PHSU's official catalogue documents a four-year MD and its academic progression requirements. An official 2024/25 MD educational budget publishes resident and non-resident tuition, fees and living-cost components, while the university portal exposes 2025/26 and 2026/27 fee links. Its admissions portal accepts applications and distinguishes visiting/international students, but a current MD-specific selection page, current cost document, language/immigration conditions and current clinical-site information were not fully verified. Hold pending those facts and an applicant-market eligibility review.
